build_decoder: build a ModelParallelTransformerDecoder with args, dictionary, and embed_tokens for model-parallel decoding
build_decoder_layer: build a single ModelParallelTransformerDecoderLayer from args with optional FSDP and checkpoint wrapping
extract_features: extract decoder features from prev_output_tokens with optional incremental state and padding mask
forward_embedding: compute token and positional embeddings with optional document-level attention position resetting
output_layer: project decoder features to vocabulary size using shared or separate output projection weights
